name: CiteLure – AI Citation Engine
author: CodeRevolution

sections.description:
Search is changing fast, users are no longer clicking links, they’re reading answers generated by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok and Google AI Overviews.

CiteLure is a dedicated WordPress plugin built for the era of Generative Search. While traditional SEO helps you rank for clicks, CiteLure helps your content get cited and summarized by AI agents.

As AI-driven search (SGE/GEO) takes over, sites that don’t structure their data for Large Language Models (LLMs) risk losing visibility. This plugin provides the essential technical bridge between your WordPress site and AI crawlers.

Key Features in the Free Version

  • AI Snapshot Block: A specialized Gutenberg block to provide “Atomic Answers” that LLMs prioritize for summaries.
  • llms.txt Generator: Automatically creates a /llms.txt file at your root – it helps AI models understand your site’s structure.
  • AI Metadata Injection: Injects clean JSON-LD metadata optimized for generative retrieval and E-E-A-T signals.
  • Markdown Discovery: Enables a lightweight feed for AI agents to process your content without HTML bloat.

Note: This is the Core plugin. For advanced automation like AI-generated summaries and automatic entity mapping, check out CiteLure Pro.

The only question that matters now:
Is your site being cited… or ignored?

What Happens After You Install

  • Your site becomes readable by AI agents
  • Your content becomes easier to summarize
  • Your pages become eligible for citations
  • Your visibility shifts from “ranked” to “referenced”

External Services

CiteLure connects to several AI APIs, depending on which features you choose to use. The plugin never sends anything unless you deliberately trigger an action such as generating text, creating an image, running a chatbot, or performing an embedding request. All calls are made using your own API keys, and no data is stored or shared by the plugin developer.

Below is a clear outline of each external service CiteLure can communicate with, what AI prompt text is sent and under which conditions. If you disable a service in the settings or never add its API key, CiteLure will not contact it.

OpenAI

Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Disclaimer

CiteLure connects your WordPress site to external AI APIs such as OpenAI. You must use your own API key and follow the terms of the AI service you choose. For OpenAI, review their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

The plugin developer is not responsible for any misuse of AI-generated content. All data is stored on your server, and it’s your responsibility to keep it secure.

This plugin is not affiliated with any of the AI services mentioned above.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the citelure folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new CiteLure menu in your dashboard to configure your AI Snapshot settings.
  4. (Optional) Check your new AI hub at yourdomain.com/llms.txt.
sections.faq:
Does this replace Yoast or RankMath?

No. CiteLure works alongside traditional SEO plugins. While they handle search engine rankings, CiteLure handles AI citation and LLM readability.

What is llms.txt?

It is an emerging convention (similar to robots.txt) specifically for AI crawlers. It provides a roadmap of your site’s most important knowledge in a format LLMs can easily digest.

Can I use this with Aiomatic?

Yes! If you use Aiomatic to generate content, CiteLure is the perfect companion to ensure that content is technically optimized for AI search engines.
